sectionRef: Rules of the Road 2026, Chapter 8 Driver’s License Revocation, Suspension, Denial and Cancellation, p. 62

definition.ru: Разрешение для водителя, права которого приостановлены за неуплату алиментов или нарушение порядка встреч с ребёнком. Выдаётся только по решению окружного судьи или по указанию Illinois Department of Healthcare and Family Services.
definition.en: A permit for a driver whose license was suspended for nonpayment of child support or child visitation abuse. It is issued only following a circuit judge’s order or on direction from the Illinois Department of Healthcare and Family Services.
